title: Design: Required-field errors in the part window look as drawn
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 1.2 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens with every box empty.

Step 2:

  • Four boxes turn red (red outline and red label), each with a small red message right under it, all at the same time: "Description is a required field", "Part number is a required field", "Category is a required field", "Cost is a required field".
  • Vendor, Manufacturer, Sell Price, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags keep their grey outline.
  • The window stays open.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-N1: “Description is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Description is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • S7-N2: “Part Number is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Part number is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Description field empty or only spaces | "Description is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part Number field empty or only spaces | "Part number is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
